base: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: game animation sprite sheet for a modular equipment prototype. Input image is a STYLE AND CHARACTER reference for the copper-haired swordsman, NOT the layout. Create one transparent-background 1536x1024 sprite sheet: exactly 4 equal columns and 3 equal rows, 12 full-body frames, evenly spaced, no labels or grid lines. Same right-facing three-quarter chibi copper-haired young adult swordsman in every frame, teal scarf, navy fitted long-sleeve tunic, brown gloves and boots, dark trousers, NO weapon, NO shield, NO metal armor, NO shoulder pads. Keep his torso mostly right-facing and same size. Right/near gloved hand clenched as if gripping a sword, clearly visible in front of the body. Top row: four restrained idle poses with fist at waist in front. Middle row: four distinct walking poses, feet alternating and fist in front. Bottom row: attack preparation with fist raised, downward swing, forward extended fist strike, recovery. Preserve identity, painted game style, crisp dark outlines, warm top-left light. All characters equal scale, 230 pixels tall within each 384x341 cell, feet around cell y=300, torso around cell x=175. Leave generous transparent margins for equipment. Actual alpha transparency, no checkerboard drawing, no ground shadows, no floor. Only unarmed base characters; interchangeable swords and chest armor will be rendered separately.
baseMatte: Edit target is this unarmed 12-frame character animation sprite sheet. Change ONLY the background. Replace the white/gray checkerboard with perfectly flat solid saturated magenta RGB(255,0,255), hex #FF00FF. This is a chroma-key production export: no gradients, no glow, no texture, no shadow, no floor. Fill every background pixel including between limbs and around scarf with exactly #FF00FF. Keep all twelve characters and all poses, positioning, scale, colors, and 1536x1024 dimensions identical. Do not add any objects or equipment.
